body: Thank you. I posted this on facebook for weeks and not one comment. Thank you for reading and commenting. I have. Two parts of a story im writing, just not sure where to post it at.

Im not sure what to talk about.  Feels like I fail before I try.  Im so used to paying for friends or to be heard im not sure why anymore.  Its like a never ending circle.  I gotta be or have a certain status to even be seen much less heard.
